name: postgres
description: PostgreSQL database integration for queries, schema inspection, and data analysis

tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: List all tables in the database

tools.name: describe_table
tools.description: Get schema information for a table

example_prompts: Show me all tables and their row counts
Find users who haven't logged in for 30 days
What indexes are missing for slow queries?
Analyze the schema and suggest normalization improvements
Find duplicate records in the customers table

notes: By default, only SELECT queries are allowed
Use a read replica when possible
Create a dedicated user with minimal permissions
Consider query timeouts for large tables
recommended_permissions: GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO claude_reader;
GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA public TO claude_reader;
ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES IN SCHEMA public GRANT SELECT ON TABLES TO claude_reader;

common_queries.table_sizes: SELECT relname, pg_size_pretty(pg_total_relation_size(relid)) FROM pg_catalog.pg_statio_user_tables ORDER BY pg_total_relation_size(relid) DESC;
common_queries.slow_queries: SELECT query, calls, mean_time, total_time FROM pg_stat_statements ORDER BY mean_time DESC LIMIT 10;
common_queries.index_usage: SELECT relname, indexrelname, idx_scan, idx_tup_read FROM pg_stat_user_indexes ORDER BY idx_scan;
common_queries.table_bloat: SELECT schemaname, relname, n_dead_tup, n_live_tup FROM pg_stat_user_tables WHERE n_dead_tup > 1000;
